map.逐期录入 GMV、订单数、退款率与获客成本，按时间顺序计算各期 GMV 环比增长: Enter GMV, order count, refund rate and customer acquisition cost period by period; compute the period-over-period GMV growth rate in chronological order, compare the period-by-period changes in refund rate and acquisition cost, automatically flag the periods that worsened (refund rate or acquisition cost up more than 0.3pt period over period), and finally give an overall review verdict of "improving / needs attention".
map.输入各期运营指标（每行：期次,GMV,订单数,退款率%,获客成本）: Enter the operating metrics for each period (one per line: period, GMV, orders, refund rate %, acquisition cost)

map.退款率/CAC 环比 = 本期 − 上期（百分点）: Refund rate / CAC change = current − previous (percentage points)
map.风险预警触发：退款率环比 +0.3pt｜CAC 环比 +0.3: Risk warning triggered: refund rate change +0.3pt | CAC change +0.3
map.整体结论：末期 GMV ≥ 首期 且 退款率、CAC 均 ≤ 首期 → 改善: Overall verdict: last-period GMV ≥ first period and both refund rate and CAC ≤ first period → improving

map.环比格式：正加 +，负不加: Change format: plus sign for positive, none for negative
map.输入至少一行五列有效数据: At least one valid row with five columns is required
map.按时间顺序粘贴多期数据（期次,GMV,订单数,退款率%,获客成本），逐期看 GM: Paste multi-period data in chronological order (period, GMV, orders, refund rate %, acquisition cost) and read the period-over-period GMV growth to judge whether growth is sustained.
map.对比退款率与获客成本的逐期变化，退款率上升或获客成本上升超过 0.3（0.3 个: Compare the period-over-period change in refund rate and acquisition cost; a rise of more than 0.3 (0.3 percentage points / 0.3 currency units) flags the period as a risk period.
map.用末期与首期的 GMV、退款率、获客成本做整体判定：三项都不恶化才输出「改善」，: Use the last and first periods' GMV, refund rate and acquisition cost for the overall verdict: only when none of the three worsened is "improving" output, otherwise "needs attention".

map.一行一期、共 5 列，用逗号或制表符分隔：期次,GMV,订单数,退款率%,获客成: One period per line with 5 columns separated by commas or tabs: period, GMV, orders, refund rate %, acquisition cost. Enter the refund rate as a percentage from 0 to 100 (e.g. 3.5 means 3.5%); out-of-range values are clamped and flagged for checking.
map.⚠️ 退款率应在 0–100% 之间，已按边界值处理，请核对原始数据。: ⚠️ Refund rate should be between 0 and 100%; out-of-range values were clamped to the boundary, please verify the source data.
map.逐期粘贴「期次,GMV,订单数,退款率%,获客成本」五行数据，工具按时间顺序算: Paste rows of "period,GMV,orders,refund rate%,acquisition cost"; the tool computes period-over-period GMV and order changes plus average order value, flags periods where refund rate or acquisition cost rose by more than 0.3, and compares the last period with the first for an "improving / needs attention" verdict.
map.逐期 GMV / 订单环比与客单价自动计算: Automatic period-over-period GMV, order and average-order-value calculation
